questions.q: What era had only three major TV channels in the U.S.?
questions.why: In the 1960s only three major TV channels existed.

questions.q: What is the first step in modern marketing according to Godin?
questions.why: He says find specific groups (tribes) first.

questions.q: What does a tribe provide for a brand?
questions.why: A tribe shares values and stories that attract customers.

questions.q: How can a company reach the general public after building a tribe?
questions.why: He suggests leveraging the tribe's networks.

questions.q: Why is advertising considered dead in Godin's view?
a: It focuses on quantity over quality
questions.why: He argues advertising is about quantity, not meaningful connection.
